data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2016 gross claims outstanding were GBP 57.106m. During the 2016 calendar year there was adverse prior-year development: the Managing Agent reports a deterioration (net) of GBP 10.9m to claims reserves established at the prior year end. The deterioration was principally driven by unfavourable development in Property, Political Risks and legacy European Creditor / Consumer Products business, resulting in a material strengthening of prior year reserves.
raw_causal_phrases: is a deterioration of GBP 10.9m (2015: improvement of GBP 0.2m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to the unfavourable development of Property, Political Risks and European Creditor business.
The net claims ratio increased by 6.0% to 42.5% for the 2016 calendar year driven largely by adverse development on prior years in the Political Risks and Consumer Products classes.

The adverse development of the 2013 & Prior years of account during the calendar year followed a number of large loss notifications on the Political Risks book in relation to the long period single premium exposures, adverse performance on certain large Consumer Products accounts, higher than anticipated levels of attrition on the legacy European Creditor business and an unfavourable settlement on a long-standing Property claim.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Marine, Aviation, Transport and NonMarine Energy
Fire and other damage to Property

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year reserve movement (GROSS) not explicitly stated. The report explicitly states a net deterioration of GBP 10.9m included within net claims incurred; no gross 'movement in prior year's provision' (insurance liabilities column) figure was provided separately. The gross claims development triangle is present but may be distorted by RITC / reinsurance-to-close activity and RITC accepted on closure of earlier years; therefore the gross triangle was not used to compute a gross PYD. Prior-year development figure provided here is NET of reinsurance as the only explicit quantified movement; flagging as NET fallback.
